name: Homey-Wan-Kenobi-MCP
description: Self-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Homey Pro smart home control. Exposes 60 tools and 3 knowledge prompts for device and zone control, standard and Advanced Flow authoring, energy and Insights analysis, Z-Wave and Zigbee mesh diagnostics, app usage analysis, and Homey infrastructure operations, over stdio or streamable-HTTP with no cloud broker and no paid AI-plan requirement. Runs on a hardened non-root node:22-alpine image. Requires a Homey Pro reachable on your LAN plus a local API key (create one at my.homey.app under Settings, API Keys). After starting, attach an MCP client to http:// :[PORT:8000]/mcp. Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Athom.

ports.name: MCP HTTP Port
ports.description: Host port for the MCP streamable-http endpoint (served at /mcp).

variables.name: HOMEY_ADDRESS
variables.description: Base URL of your Homey Pro local API, e.g. http://192.168.1.50 . Must be reachable from this container.

variables.name: HOMEY_TOKEN
variables.description: Homey local API key. Create one at my.homey.app under Settings, API Keys.

variables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
variables.description: Leave as streamable-http for the persistent HTTP service. Set to stdio only if a client launches the container itself.
